title: Rethinking Irregular Time Series Forecasting from the Perspective of Basis Functions
abstract: arXiv:2608.17284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Irregular time series forecasting is crucial in many domains, such as healthcare and meteorological observation. However, due to the inherent characteristics of irregular time series, including sparse observations and non-uniform sampling, accurately predicting future dynamics remains challenging. In light of these two characteristics, many existing methods aggregate irregular observations into fixed-dimensional estimated response coefficients through predefined basis functions and use these coefficients as sequence representations. Nevertheless, this modeling paradigm still suffers from two key limitations: (i) a potential non-vanishing asymptotic bias caused by ignoring the sampling density of timestamps; and (ii) the limited adaptability of predefined basis functions to diverse temporal patterns. translated_title: 从基函数视角重新思考不规则时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 不规则时间序列预测在医疗保健和气象观测等许多领域至关重要。然而，由于不规则时间序列的固有特性，包括稀疏观测和非均匀采样，准确预测未来动态仍然具有挑战性。针对这两个特性，许多现有方法通过预定义基函数将不规则观测聚合为固定维度的估计响应系数，并将这些系数用作序列表示。然而，这种建模范式仍然存在两个关键局限性：（i）由于忽略时间戳的采样密度，可能导致潜在的非消失渐近偏差；（ii）预定义基函数对多样时间模式的适应性有限。在本研究中，我们提出了一种去偏神经基函数网络（DNBNet）来解决这些挑战。其核心是一个去偏神经基函数网络，旨在克服上述局限性。
tldr: 本文提出DNBNet，通过去偏神经基函数网络解决不规则时间序列预测中因忽略采样密度导致的渐近偏差和预定义基函数适应性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DNBNet, a debiased neural basis-function network, to address asymptotic bias from ignored sampling density and limited adaptability of predefined basis functions in irregular time series forecasting.
